mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees e WHERE e.work_status = '01' AND e.employment_status = '01' AND e.deleted_at IS NULL
AND e.sales_user_id = #{salesUserId}

SELECT e.employee_id AS employeeId, e.employee_no AS employeeNo, e.employee_name AS employeeName,
TIMESTAMPDIFF( YEAR, e.birth_date, CURRENT_DATE ) AS age,
e.nearest_station AS nearestStation, e.work_status AS workStatusCode,
CASE e.work_status WHEN '01' THEN '待機中' WHEN '02' THEN '面談調整中' WHEN '03' THEN '稼働中' WHEN '04' THEN '休職中' WHEN '09' THEN '退職済み' ELSE '不明' END AS workStatusName,
( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( s.skill_name ORDER BY es.skill_level DESC, es.experience_months DESC SEPARATOR ', ' ) FROM employee_skills es INNER JOIN skills s ON s.skill_id = es.skill_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.is_active = TRUE WHERE es.employee_id = e.employee_id AND es.deleted_at IS NULL ) AS primarySkills,
p.project_name AS currentProjectName, a.contract_end_date AS contractEndDate,
CASE WHEN a.contract_end_date IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE DATEDIFF( a.contract_end_date, CURRENT_DATE ) END AS remainingDays,
u.user_name AS salesUserName,
CASE WHEN a.contract_end_date IS NULL THEN '00' WHEN a.contract_end_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN '03' WHEN DATEDIFF( a.contract_end_date, CURRENT_DATE ) <= 14 THEN '02' WHEN DATEDIFF( a.contract_end_date, CURRENT_DATE ) <= 30 THEN '01' ELSE '00' END AS warningLevelCode
FROM employees e
INNER JOIN users u ON u.user_id = e.sales_user_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
LEFT JOIN assignments a ON a.assignment_id = ( SELECT a_current.assignment_id FROM assignments a_current WHERE a_current.employee_id = e.employee_id AND a_current.assignment_status = '02' AND a_current.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY a_current.contract_start_date DESC, a_current.assignment_id DESC LIMIT 1 )
LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = a.project_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
WHERE
ORDER BY CASE WHEN a.contract_end_date IS NULL THEN 4 WHEN a.contract_end_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 WHEN DATEDIFF( a.contract_end_date, CURRENT_DATE ) <= 14 THEN 2 WHEN DATEDIFF( a.contract_end_date, CURRENT_DATE ) <= 30 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END ASC, a.contract_end_date ASC, e.employee_no ASC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE employee_no = #{employeeNo}

SELECT employee_id AS employeeId, employee_no AS employeeNo, employee_name AS employeeName, birth_date AS birthDate, phone_no AS phoneNo, postal_code AS postalCode, address, nearest_station AS nearestStation, join_date AS joinDate, employment_status AS employmentStatus, work_status AS workStatus, sales_user_id AS salesUserId, remarks FROM employees WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employees ( employee_no, employee_name, birth_date, phone_no, postal_code, address, nearest_station, join_date, employment_status, work_status, sales_user_id, remarks, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{employeeNo}, #{employeeName}, #{birthDate}, #{phoneNo}, #{postalCode}, #{address}, #{nearestStation}, #{joinDate}, #{employmentStatus}, #{workStatus}, #{salesUserId}, #{remarks}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE employees SET employee_name = #{employeeName}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, phone_no = #{phoneNo}, postal_code = #{postalCode}, address = #{address}, nearest_station = #{nearestStation}, join_date = #{joinDate}, employment_status = #{employmentStatus}, work_status = #{workStatus}, sales_user_id = #{salesUserId}, remarks = #{remarks}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE interview_questions iq INNER JOIN interviews i ON i.interview_id = iq.interview_id SET iq.deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, iq.updated_by = #{loginUserId} WHERE i.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND iq.deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE matching_results SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
